data.name: Ebeniel
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Ebeniel means "Stone of God". It is a compound name derived from the Hebrew words eben (stone) and El (God). In the Bible, there are several individuals with this name, including a Levite gatekeeper in the Second Temple Period and a son of Joram, king of Judah.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing faith and strength in God.

in_hebrew.name: אבניאל
in_hebrew.meaning: אבן אלוהים, אבן של אלוהים, אבניאל בן אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אבניאל הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'אבן אלוהים' או 'אבן של אלוהים'. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'אבן' שפירושה 'אבן' או 'אבן חן', ו'אל' או 'אלוהים' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם אבניאל מופיע בתנ"ך כבן של אחד הנביאים.

in_greek.name: Εβενιήλ
in_greek.meaning: Εβενιήλ, υιός του Θεού, πέτρα του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εβενιήλ είναι εβραϊκής προέλευσης και σημαίνει 'πέτρα του Θεού' ή 'υιός του Θεού'. Η λέξη 'εβέν' σημαίνει 'πέτρα' ή 'λίθος', ενώ 'ηλ' ή 'Θεός' σημαίνει 'Θεός'. Το όνομα Εβενιήλ χρησιμοποιήθηκε στην αρχαία Εκκλησία ως σύμβολο της πίστης και της σταθερότητας.

in_latin.name: Ebeniel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ebeniel origine hebraica est et significat 'Filius Dei' vel 'Petra Dei'. Vox 'eben' significat 'lapis' vel 'petra', et 'El' seu 'Deus' significat 'Deus'. Nomen Ebeniel in Ecclesia primitiva adhibitum est ut symbolum fidei et stabilitatis.

in_english.name: Ebeniel
in_english.meaning: Son of God, Stone of God, God is my stone
in_english.long_meaning: Ebeniel is a Christian name derived from Hebrew roots, meaning 'Son of God' or 'Stone of God'. It combines 'eben', meaning 'stone' or 'rock', with 'El', meaning 'God'. The name Ebeniel symbolizes faith, strength, and divine connection. It is used across Christian cultures to signify a strong spiritual foundation.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ebeniel carries an important cultural significance as it is rooted in the ancient Hebrew language and has biblical connections. It is a name that resonates with a rich history, emphasizing the enduring presence of God as a source of strength and solidity - much like the meaning of the word 'ebenezer', a biblical term meaning 'stone of help'. This can serve as a reminder of the stability and fortitude that comes from having faith in God.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Ebeniel represents an unwavering connection to God. It symbolizes a deep-rooted faith, emphasizing the belief in the divine powers that protect and guide us through life's challenges. The name reverberates with the concept of God being the foundation of our existence and the cornerstone of our faith. It's a reminder that just as a stone provides a strong foundation, God is the unwavering foundation of our spiritual lives.

historical_references.reference: Ebennel, son of Nehemiah, is mentioned in the Old Testament book of Nehemiah as one of the chief men who helped rebuild the wall of Jerusalem in 445 BC.

During the Middle Ages, a saint named Ebennel or Ebenezer was venerated in various European regions. He was believed to be a hermit who lived in the forest of Ardennes, modern-day Belgium, around the 6th or 7th century AD.

trends: Used as a unique name in various parts of the world including Africa, Asia, and South America
Popular among Christian communities as a unisex name meaning 'God is my stone' or 'God is my source'

data.spiritual_symbolism: Ebeniel: Stone of God. A name given to one who embodies strength and faith, being a living testament to the power and presence of God in their life.
